summary: LivePerson Inc. filed an 8-K announcing entry into a merger agreement to be acquired by SoundHound AI Inc. LivePerson shareholders will receive shares of SoundHound Class A common stock based on a formula: the aggregate consideration is $42,784,532.64 minus LivePerson Shortfall Cash plus in-the-money option exercise prices, divided by the SoundHound closing stock price to determine the per-share merger consideration. The merger is structured as a reverse triangular merger with LivePerson surviving as an indirect wholly owned subsidiary of SoundHound, taxable for U.S. federal income tax purposes. No board recommendation or advisor named. Watch for regulatory approvals and SoundHound stock price volatility affecting deal value.
